name: LearningToOptimize
thumb_alt: LearningToOptimize.jl workflow: a JuMP model and a problem iterator generate primal and dual solutions, stored as tables, then used to train models.
tagline: Turns a parametric JuMP model into datasets of decisions, multipliers and sensitivities, and trains and evaluates optimization proxies on them.

name: DecisionRules.jl
thumb_alt: Training a state-target policy: a recurrent policy emits targets stage by stage, and the multipliers of the target constraints of independent stage problems train it.
tagline: Trains policies whose state targets are realized by an optimization over the operating model, with gradients from the multipliers of the target constraints.

name: HydroPowerModels.jl
thumb_alt: Nested relaxations of the AC power-flow feasible set: SDP inside SOC inside network flow inside copper plate.
tagline: Multistage hydrothermal planning by SDDP over any PowerModels network formulation, with one formulation computing the cuts and another operating the system.

name: PortfolioOpt.jl
thumb_alt: Cumulative wealth during a rolling backtest for nominal and robust allocation strategies.
tagline: Composes uncertainty models, risk measures and their role as objective or constraint into tractable nominal, robust and distributionally robust programs, evaluated in rolling backtests.

name: OptimalBids.jl
thumb_alt: Bayesian optimization fitting a Gaussian-process surrogate to a jagged profit curve.
tagline: Reduces a market to four operations, so derivative-free search, gradient search and exact bilevel reformulations act on one market definition.

name: DiffOpt.jl
thumb_alt: Dispatch and price of a small economic-dispatch problem as demand varies, with the solution derivatives that DiffOpt.jl computes.
tagline: Solution and optimal-value derivatives of JuMP models with respect to named parameters, through the model's reformulations, for convex and smooth nonconvex programs.
